findings.description: The positional-arguments help section now passes each argument's get_help_record result straight to write_dl. For an Argument with no help text, that record is (metavar, None), not (metavar, ""), so write_dl receives a None description.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with at least one positional argument that has help set and another positional argument with help left unset, so the section is rendered. Mechanism: the removed code substituted (make_metavar, "") for falsy records, but the new code no longer does, and get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) with self.help being None. write_dl then measures and wraps the None value, which click's text helpers do not accept, so it raises TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for such commands instead of printing the usage text.
